question: which icon, manifest, tile and video requests reach the origin on each navigation, by cache headers, worker and engine, and whether a worker sees them
instrument: request log of the in-process origin, plus the worker's own log of the fetch events it received

software.browsers: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, Playwright bundled builds
software.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.1.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

method.arms: cache headers (shipping: max-age=0 with an ETag; optimized: one year immutable) by worker (none, document, icons)
method.first view: a prime navigation to /p/1, then a reload once a worker controls the page
method.navigations: 4 declared pages (every icon tag), then 4 bare pages (no icon tag), typed navigations
method.video: one page per preload mode: load, play, reload, play again

exclusions: rows in a worker arm with controlled false, the worker never took control
rows from headless Chromium, which requests no icons
